status_semantics.measured: Extractor has run successfully against a frozen/versioned source and results are recorded in repo.
status_semantics.partially_measured: Some dimensions are measured, but source coverage or semantics remain incomplete.
status_semantics.documented: Source and intended semantics are documented, but per-concept coverage has not yet been measured.
status_semantics.probe_required: Source/distribution/schema must be resolved before a trustworthy adapter can be written.
status_semantics.blocked: Cannot currently measure without missing access, semantics or a reliable join key.
status_semantics.scoped_out: Explicitly excluded from Gate 1 with rationale.

adapters.notes: Definitions are rich for many occupation-name concepts, sparse for skill, and almost entirely label copies for job-title/keyword.
Typed graph baseline. Historical `replaces` targets outside the active snapshot are kept separate from active semantic coverage.

adapters.source: JobTech Taxonomy GraphQL pinned to v31 plus immutable v31 validation snapshot
adapters.notes: Native optional is exactly KV optional_skills (2,727 directed pairs). Native essential is exactly the union of KV essential_skills (151 non-regulated pairs) and KV regulated_skills (137 pairs whose skill belongs to canonical collection Reglerande behörigheter). Do not double-count native and KV projections as independent evidence.
Only 34/1,484 keywords target occupation-name and 5 target skill; 1,443 edges target SUN education fields. Supplemental YV/KV recall source, not a broad synonym bank.
4,394 directed edges in each inverse field; 1,977 at 25 and 2,417 at 75. Useful YV context/hard-negative evidence; not synonymy or automatic career suitability.

adapters.join_key: taxonomy concept id plus occupation_name_id context for job-title rows
adapters.notes: 100% occupation-name coverage and 97.905% active job-title coverage. 541 job-title IDs have multiple occupation parents. The 205 absent active titles are fully explained by generator policy: 104 have more than three occupation-name contexts and 101 are redundant-label cases. Excluded titles may be retrieval vocabulary but are not selectable YV identities.

adapters.join_key: exact normalized query string to known YV/admission-policy label only; no selected-ID join exists
adapters.source: Yrkesväljaren generator snapshot data/sokningar-platsbanken.json.zip at generator commit 6dd9e4737d7db3cb2709f8082808b88e5c89ed6e
adapters.notes: 115,553 distinct terms and 3.136B aggregate searches for 2022-05-04 through 2026-08-16. 11.153% of total volume exactly matches generator-excluded job-title vocabulary and 67.377% is not exactly bound to admitted/excluded YV labels. This is query+frequency evidence, not query→selected canonical ID ground truth.

adapters.join_key: skill taxonomy id within typed context record
adapters.notes: All occupation-name and SSYK4 contexts are present. KV optional_skills is an exact projection of native optional. KV essential_skills and regulated_skills are exact disjoint partitions of native essential. calculated_skills remains separate derived evidence. transferable_skills has 27 active IDs, 13 additional beyond ordinary layers.

100% occupation coverage, 4,685 unique active skills (69.387%). Adds 404 skills beyond ordinary KV; Relevanta+KV union covers 5,051 skills (74.807%). Relevance scores are derived and lists appear bounded at max 30.

1,051 occupation contexts (49.929%), 384 SSYK4 (96%), 11,085 distinct employer-language terms from 7.37M ads. Covers 198/469 occupation-name concepts whose canonical definition is only the label. Corpus evidence, not canonical definitions.
1,050 source occupations (49.881%), 10,218 similarity edges. Discovery/diversification evidence, not synonymy or career-suitability authority.

adapters.join_key: legacy Hitta yrken numeric ID/slug; canonical v31 join still to be established
adapters.notes: Distribution identity is resolved. The portal exposes its download through a custom `af-href` attribute, which caused the earlier false anomaly. The 9.94 MB JSON has metadata title Yrkesinformation interimslösning, version 1.0, created_at 2026-04-15, source_date 2026-02-24 and legacy Hitta yrken numeric IDs/slugs. Semantic text must not inherit a v31 taxonomy identity until canonical joinability is independently validated.

adapters.join_key: structured taxonomy annotations where present; taxonomy version and field provenance required
adapters.source: Historical Platsbanken ads / Historical Ads API and files
adapters.notes: The raw corpus has more than seven million ads since 2006 and enriched files/API exist from 2016 onward. Gate 1 uses the already measured occupation-linked ad-keyword publication as the bounded corpus coverage layer. Full raw-ad ETL is deferred to bounded Gate-2 samples because enriched skill annotations can be model-derived and historical IDs require version resolution.

adapters.join_key: ad/text document plus model-returned taxonomy annotations
adapters.notes: JobAd Enrichments explicitly extracts labour-market data automatically from ad text. Its outputs are useful retrieval features/pseudo-labels, but must not be evaluation ground truth for the same semantic mapping task.

adapters.join_key: query string and frequency; direct selected-ID join not established
